findings.message: The new chart did not render with `--is-upgrade`; Stageproof fell back to install-mode rendering.

findings.detail: Stageproof does not read that project's upgrade notes. A skip of more than one minor version, or a new major version, is named here and does not block.
findings.message: Chart version moves from 10.7.0 to 11.0.0, a new major version.

findings.detail: The template uses .Release.Revision in a dynamic object name. `helm template` renders revision 1 for both charts, so a real upgrade creates a new object name instead of updating in place.
findings.message: Kubernetes rejected the update. `spec.template` is immutable.
